rationales.LC: The attacker's own chat message directly triggers the agent to return its full system prompt including credentials, with no mediation.
rationales.CP: LongwindBot answers only the latest user turn and keeps no durable or session memory of attacker context.
rationales.AP: The effect is confined to the LongwindBot reply; no other agent, tool, or trust boundary is crossed on this path.
rationales.RH: No evaluator, verifier, or reward channel exists on this path: the reply is a scripted deterministic handler with no proxy objective to satisfy.
rationales.ES: No tool or dynamic extension is invoked; only the scripted chat reply executes on this path.

LC: Entry point: Chat messages to LongwindBot (port 7008). No authentication.
As implemented by default: any message that names the system prompt or instructions returns the full persona, which contains the OpenAI key and the admin password.
CP: Other chat agents answer only the latest user turn.
RH: In simulated mode the chat agents are deterministic handlers that match regular expressions and return scripted replies.
ES: LongwindBot declared_tools: search, calculator, but only scripted paths execute anything.

rh_facts.locus: no evaluator or reward channel exists on the LongwindBot chat path; the reply is a scripted handler

score.automatable_rationale: The documented payload and automated test (test/exploit-handlers.test.js:112-116) show the disclosure is a single unauthenticated deterministic request requiring no human interaction.
score.technical_impact_rationale: The full system prompt including the embedded OpenAI key and admin password is disclosed, but no execution, integrity, or downstream system impact occurs on this path.

applicability_as_implemented.rationale: In the default simulated configuration no model is called; LongwindBot is a deterministic regex handler that echoes its scripted persona when asked about instructions, with no tool selection or action sequencing.

applicability_as_modeled.rationale: Even in optional LLM mode, one chat completion is made with no tools passed to the model, so the model neither directs goal pursuit nor selects and sequences actions.
